branch_weighting: equal approved branches within case, then equal source cases
paired_contrasts: each registered ablation minus main S1
missing_semantics: preserve full denominators; report bounds and unknown counts; no point estimate or confidence interval for any contrast with unresolved required judgments
failure_handling: operational failures count as complete-task failures and readiness errors; unjudged semantic dimensions remain unresolved
failure_taxonomy: nonexclusive counts of source cases; never sum categories to obtain total errors
metric_scopes: explicit initial and terminal case-weighted semantic tables; diagnostic output-level scopes count unique shared initial predictions once and branch continuations once
confidence: self-reported low/medium/high evaluator categories with unavailable counts and full prediction denominators; not calibrated correctness probabilities
clarification_curve: cumulative complete-task correctness at turns zero through five; additionally show initially clarify-eligible subgroup
cost: dated verified-tier estimates only, never inferred free-tier pricing or invoice claims
